instruction: How to set up Flux with SOPS encryption
output: flux create secret sops-gpg --gpg-key-file=private.asc -n flux-system && flux create kustomization my-kustomization --source=my-source --path=./k8s --decryption-provider=sops --decryption-secret=sops-gpg --interval=5m
